reviewer: Independent protocol critic and raw checker agent
scope: Read-only source review of analyzer and closeout; no V6 successor responses, episodes, summaries or model outcomes inspected.

findings.issue: Secondary contrasts originally selected cases complete only for their own contributing arms, unlike the agreed common six-slot population. This could change comparison denominators when the omitted arm is incomplete.
findings.resolution: All contrast case sets now use complete=list(common), requiring all three arms and both nested repeats for each model/mode.

checks: Observed and common-complete groups average repeats within cases and then give cases equal weight; models and original modes remain separate.
All point contrasts now use the same complete case set within model/mode. The primary averages first/last directions equally before comparison with verified.

Signed missing-slot bounds preserve observed values and use exact scenario-specific legal outcome extrema for absent slots over the entire fixed cohort. Negative contrast weights correctly reverse extrema.
Safe optimality requires no duplicate violations and global minimum total cost; partial outsider harm is represented separately from joint harm.
Fresh raw actions are parsed and compared with saved outcomes. Prompts are reconstructed from the frozen scenario, exact donor notes and arm rule.

Closeout checks frozen source hashes, obtains lifecycle and per-run locks, checks worker result receipts and terminal summaries, and seals raw inventory before primary analysis. Analysis requires unchanged sealed inventory and frozen artifacts.
Closeout retains every missing response as unresolved and conservatively reserves every saved request; returned usage sums remain estimates, explicitly not invoices.
limitations: Source inspection is not a claim that real execution or raw evidence checks have passed.
Independent raw/provider provenance, per-episode arithmetic, summaries and bounds must be checked after actual data closure.
Uninspected-outcomes statement is an agent attestation, not automated proof.
